correctness.rationale: Jordan identity decomposes gcd² and complete multiplicativity extracts |S_a(⌊N/d⌋)|². Exact floor expansion of F_a(x) into pairs weighted by 1/max(k,l) has O(H_⌊x⌋²) floor error and O(log x) tail, independently of the unit-modulus phases. Möbius-divisor convolution gives 1/ζ(3), with summable errors and an O(log² N) bound uniform in a. Telescoping of 1/[q(q+1)] yields nonnegative c; triangle inequality and Σ_r H_r/r²=2ζ(3) give c≤3 and uniqueness. Verified small exact rational direct/Jordan/floor-sum values for nonconstant signs.
